title: A non-oracle action catalogue for intent-phrase planning
decision: Run a bounded head-only pilot to test whether learned catalogue expansion supports useful non-oracle depth-two and depth-four JEPA planning.
plain_summary: The planner now expands a fixed prompt-derived action catalogue with learned availability and policy scores, never queries symbolic feasibility while imagining trajectories, preserves a separate beam per root, and passes all 119 repository tests.
